BasicConcept: A intimidating growl that keeps the target back.
BasicEffect: Stuns target so they can't attack this turn.
BasicBonus: Stuns target for x many more turns.
BasicPenalty: Stuns user and their Tamer for x many turns.
StandardPenalty: Bonus to attacks against user this round.
SpecialConcept: Cuts into the target with oblivion infused teeth.
SpecialBonus: Does 3 Damage to the Target on it's next x turns.
SpecialPenalty: Stuns the user on their next turn.
SuperConcept: Barks forth a blast of a darkness.
SuperBonus: Nerfs target's next attack roll by x dice.
SuperPenalty: Stuns the user on their next turn.
